about: Get a death notification or certificate, or a copy or replacement, for a death outside a hospital.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The deceased's relatives up to the fourth degree, their legal representative, or the person named in the police letter can apply
documents: Emirates ID or family book for a citizen, Emirates ID or passport for an expatriate (the deceased)
No-objection letter from Dubai Police for issuing the certificate
Dubai Police forensic report when the death was outside a healthcare facility
Copy of the recipient's Emirates ID
For a copy, a copy of the death certificate; for a replacement, a Dubai Police lost-certificate letter
fees: AED 70 for each copy or replacement
timing: New issue available 24 hours a day; replacements 7:30 AM to 3:30 PM
